propositions: _collect_node_ids launches a nested pytest collection subprocess without --basetemp, causing it to use the default shared numbered temp root
pytest session shutdown in the nested subprocess can delete or stall traversing another run's temp tree in the shared numbered root via cleanup_numbered_dir/rmtree
passing a caller-owned private --basetemp directory to _collect_node_ids prevents sibling process interference while preserving collection selection and output contract
the regression test demonstrates that without private basetemp, a preexisting sentinel in the shared numbered root is deleted or modified during nested collection cleanup
with the fix applied, nested pytest collection with private basetemp preserves exact entries and bytes in the shared numbered root
